locations.note: The train stops at Penza for a mission, and the Legion recruits more men.
Samara is a named stop on the Legion's eastbound route through the Russian Civil War.
A main mission takes place at Chelyabinsk as the train continues toward Siberia.
The story and rail journey reach Omsk, a main-mission stop in the campaign.
The 1918–19 campaign calls this stop Novo-Nikolaevsk, the historical name of modern Novosibirsk.
The train and its crew reach Krasnoyarsk on the way east across Siberia.
Irkutsk is a named main-mission stop on the Siberian journey.
The route reaches Chita before continuing through the Russian Far East and Manchuria.
The route swings through Harbin on the Chinese Eastern Railway, as the Legion's trains did, before the last stretch to Vladivostok.
The historical station name Nikolsk-Ussuriysky refers to modern Ussuriysk, a stop shortly before Vladivostok.
Vladivostok is the destination of the Legion's eastbound journey and the campaign's final major stop.
